tables.explanation: Analysis stage: The CNN+BERT concatenation model in the repository IS conceptually a 'Simple Concat' approach (CNNVisionEncoder features + BERT features concatenated via torch.cat). However, the claimed 85.1% MNIST accuracy does not appear in any execution record. The best MNIST accuracy found across all experiment logs is 71.83% (draft_summary.json stage 1/2) and 69.33% (stage 3). The claimed value is ~13 percentage points higher than the best achieved result. No script or hyperparameter combination is shown to produce 85.1%. The provenance of this specific value cannot be established from any existing artifact.
